rationale: Entire item is enzyme kinetics/saturation, competitive vs. noncompetitive inhibition, allosteric regulation, and temperature effects on enzyme activity -- all core Unit 3 enzyme content.
Traces protein through RER-Golgi-lysosome-secretory pathway and endomembrane system compartmentalization, which is Unit 2 cell structure/compartmentalization content.
Part A tests endosymbiotic origin of mitochondria (Unit 2, 2.10), while Parts B-D test chemiosmosis, ETC inhibitors, and ATP synthase mechanism (Unit 3, 3.5), so the item genuinely spans two units.
Glycolysis, pyruvate oxidation, Krebs cycle, ATP yield, and fermentation under anaerobic conditions are all cellular respiration content (3.5).
Insulin RTK signaling cascade, GPCR comparison, constitutive receptor activation, and cancer-driving mutations (HER2/Ras/PTEN) are all cell communication and its dysregulation, taught in Unit 4.
PIC assembly, enhancers/Mediator, chromatin/HAT-HDAC regulation, and combinatorial/epigenetic control of cell-type-specific expression are all Unit 6 gene regulation content.
Enzyme saturation kinetics and distinguishing competitive from noncompetitive inhibition by experimental design are core Unit 3 enzyme content.
Light-dependent reactions, electron flow through photosystems, and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis in the thylakoid are photosynthesis content (3.4).
Criterion (a) requires knowing mitosis's chromosome output (Unit 4, 4.5 Cell Cycle) to compare against meiosis II output, while (b) is pure meiotic genetic-variation content (Unit 5).
Monohybrid cross, Punnett square, and the law of segregation tied to meiosis are Mendelian genetics content.
5' capping/poly-A tail addition and alternative splicing producing distinct proteins are RNA processing and gene-expression-diversity content.
Beetle camouflage/differential predation and increasing allele frequency across generations is natural selection content.
Hardy-Weinberg allele/genotype frequency calculation and its equilibrium assumptions are direct 7.5 content.
Geographic isolation leading to reproductive isolation (pre- and post-zygotic mechanisms) is speciation content.
Energy pyramid, the 10% rule, and its downstream effect on predator/prey population sizes are Unit 8 energy-flow and population content.
Endosymbiotic-theory evidence and mitochondrial membrane origin is 2.10 (Origins of Cell Compartmentalization) content.
Insulin negative feedback and the childbirth positive feedback example are direct Feedback (4.4) content.
Peptide bond formation via dehydration synthesis and fatty-acid hydrophobicity are Unit 1 macromolecule content.
pH-dependent enzyme conformation and denaturation of pepsin/trypsin is Environmental Impacts on Enzyme Function content.
Hydrogen bonding, high specific heat, and water's polarity dissolving ionic solutes are 1.1 water-properties content.
Comparing organelles present in plant vs. bacterial cells and the cost/replication tradeoffs of compartmentalization is Cell Structure and Function content.
Endosymbiotic-theory evidence and dual-membrane origin of mitochondria is 2.10 content.
Plant cell response to hypertonic/hypotonic solutions (plasmolysis, cell wall preventing bursting) is Tonicity and Osmoregulation content.
Fatty-acid saturation and cholesterol effects on membrane fluidity are Plasma Membrane content.
Glucose transport via GLUT proteins and contrasting facilitated diffusion with active transport are membrane permeability/transport content.
Receptor-mediated endocytosis and its selectivity is bulk membrane transport content.
ATP yield comparison between aerobic respiration and fermentation, and NAD+ regeneration, is cellular respiration content.
Blocking ATP synthase and its effect on oxidative phosphorylation vs. substrate-level phosphorylation is cellular respiration content.
RTK dimerization/autophosphorylation and constitutive activation driving uncontrolled division is signal transduction and cell-cycle dysregulation content.
Dihybrid cross phenotypic ratio and probability calculation is Mendelian genetics content.
X-linked recessive color-blindness inheritance is non-Mendelian (sex-linked) genetics content.
Incomplete dominance in snapdragon flower color is non-Mendelian genetics content.
Codominance/multiple-allele ABO blood typing contrasted with incomplete dominance is non-Mendelian genetics content.
Meiosis I nondisjunction producing aneuploid gametes (trisomy 21 viability) is Meiosis content.
Promoter binding/RNA polymerase recruitment and 5' cap/poly-A tail function are Transcription and RNA Processing content.
Genetic bottleneck, drift, and reduced genetic variation raising extinction vulnerability is population genetics content.
Geographic barrier stopping gene flow and resulting reproductive isolation mechanisms is speciation content.
Antibiotic resistance evolving via selection (not Lamarckian inheritance) is natural selection content.
The 10% energy-transfer rule across trophic levels and its calculation is Energy Flow Through Ecosystems content.
Eutrophication from nutrient runoff causing algal bloom and oxygen depletion is an ecosystem disruption tied to energy flow.
Sea otter keystone-species trophic cascade affecting kelp forest biodiversity is community ecology/biodiversity content.
Classifying commensalism vs. mutualism (barnacle-whale, bee-flower) is community ecology/species interaction content.
Wolf-moose predator-prey cycling and carrying capacity/overshoot dynamics is population and community ecology content.
Water potential, osmosis direction, and turgor pressure feedback in plant cells is Tonicity and Osmoregulation content.
Chromosome arrangement after meiosis I/II and mechanisms generating genetic diversity are core Meiosis content.
Restriction enzyme digestion and gel electrophoresis fragment separation is Biotechnology content.
Secondary vs. primary succession and shade tolerance in climax community formation is Disruptions in Ecosystems content.
Amino acid substitution disrupting protein folding, distinguishing primary from tertiary structure, is Proteins content.

Mycorrhizal fungus-plant mutualism (phosphorus for carbohydrate exchange) is community ecology/symbiosis content.
Gap junctions allowing direct cell-to-cell electrical signaling in cardiac muscle is local (direct-contact) cell communication content.
Coral-zooxanthellae mutualism, bleaching, and resulting biodiversity loss is community ecology/disruption content.
Stabilizing vs. directional selection acting on birth-weight distribution is a natural-selection-mode/variation content.
Biological species concept, gene flow blocked by a river, and incipient speciation is core speciation content.
Gross vs. net primary productivity and light limitation on energy available to consumers is Energy Flow Through Ecosystems content.
Frameshift vs. substitution mutation severity and premature stop codon effects are Mutations content.
Transposon relocation as a source of genetic variation and gene disruption is Mutations content.
Criterion (a) is CRISPR-Cas9 guide RNA/Cas9 mechanism (Biotechnology, 6.8), while (b) is about tumor suppressor function and cell-cycle dysregulation leading to tumors (4.6).
Species-specific mating calls (prezygotic) and postzygotic isolating mechanisms are speciation content.
Synapomorphy/symplesiomorphy, cladogram construction, and parsimony are core Phylogeny content.
Molecular clock hypothesis and divergence-time estimation from sequence data are Evidence of Evolution/Phylogeny content.
Homoplasy misleading morphological phylogenies, molecular vs. morphological reliability, and species/subspecies evidence criteria are Phylogeny/Speciation content.

The item is primarily a hand-drawn boxplot-construction/comparison quantitative-skill task, but its biology framing (catalase reaction rate at two temperatures) sits squarely in Environmental Impacts on Enzyme Function; confidence is medium because the graded criteria test graphing mechanics more than biology reasoning.

Segmented-bar-graph construction of genotype frequency shift after pesticide exposure is a natural-selection/allele-frequency-change scenario, though the graded criteria are mostly graphing mechanics rather than evolutionary reasoning.

This item tests dot-plot construction and distribution-shape description (skew, tail) using seed germination timing as a data context, but no criterion actually requires AP Biology content knowledge (no CED topic on germination-time variation is tested); the Unit 5 assignment is a weak best-fit based on the reproductive/developmental context, not a confident content match.

The BIOLOGICAL_INTERPRETATION criterion explicitly requires explaining forage biomass as a limiting resource for population size, which is core Population Ecology (8.3) content beyond the scatterplot-construction mechanics.
RNA World hypothesis evidence (ribozymes, peptidyl transferase) is Origins of Life on Earth content.
Na+/K+ pump requiring ATP vs. spontaneous leak-channel diffusion is active transport (Mechanisms of Transport) content.

Aquaporin-2 membrane insertion and its effect on water reabsorption/osmoregulation is primarily membrane transport content, though the ADH-triggered vesicle fusion mechanism also borders on cell communication (Unit 4).
Contrasting water-soluble (membrane-receptor, fast) vs. lipid-soluble (nuclear-receptor, gene-expression, slow) hormone signaling is Cell Communication/Signal Transduction content.
Apoptosis via caspase pathways sculpting interdigital tissue is programmed cell death/cell cycle regulation content.
GPCR/Gs-protein/cAMP pathway and a db-cAMP rescue experiment interpretation is signal transduction content.
IP3/DAG second-messenger pathway and PKC co-activation is Signal Transduction Pathways content.
cAMP accumulation with a phosphodiesterase inhibitor in a Gs-coupled pathway is signal transduction content.
The item directly compares mitosis (cell type P, Unit 4 Cell Cycle) with meiosis I/II chromosome behavior (cell type Q, Unit 5 Meiosis), requiring knowledge of both.
TSH-secreting tumor bypassing the T3 negative feedback loop is Feedback content.
Incomplete dominance (pink snapdragons, gene-dosage pigment levels) is non-Mendelian genetics content.
Color-blindness pedigree analysis for X-linked recessive inheritance is non-Mendelian (sex-linked) genetics content.
Epistasis producing a 9:7 ratio from a two-gene pigment pathway is non-Mendelian genetics content.
Directionality/template-strand rules in transcription and translation is Unit 6 gene-expression mechanics content.
5' capping's role in downstream mRNA processing/export/translation is Transcription and RNA Processing content.
Structural/mechanistic differences between prokaryotic and eukaryotic gene expression is Unit 6 content, though it is grounded in Unit 2 compartmentalization (nucleus vs. no nucleus).
Enhancer-deletion and liver-specific transcription factor experiments demonstrating tissue-specific gene expression are Regulation of Gene Expression/Cell Specialization content.
Alternative splicing expanding proteome complexity beyond gene number is RNA processing/gene-expression content.
PCR primer annealing and the effect of a target-sequence mutation on amplification is Biotechnology content (note the item's own remediation log cites EK 6.8.A.1).
Bimodal beak-size distribution from resource-based selection is disruptive natural selection content.
Contrasting allopatric and sympatric speciation is direct Speciation content.
Distinguishing shared-derived (synapomorphy) from shared-ancestral traits across vertebrate taxa is Phylogeny content.

Sea otter removal causing a kelp-forest trophic cascade is keystone-species/community ecology content.
Primary succession on volcanic rock and increasing species richness improving resilience is biodiversity/ecosystem-disruption content.
Calculating energy available to a 4th trophic level using the 10% ecological-efficiency rule is Energy Flow Through Ecosystems content.
r- vs. K-selected life-history strategies relative to carrying capacity is Population Ecology content.
Linking tropical-forest biodiversity to carbon-storage ecosystem services is biodiversity/ecosystem-disruption content.
